further_archive.title: Almost bi-Lipschitz Euclidean embeddings of compact doubling spaces
further_archive.reason: Fukano, arXiv:2610.40601, submitted 29 October 2026, announces almost bi-Lipschitz Euclidean embeddability of every compact doubling metric space, with logarithmic exponent greater than one. This directly matches the unrestricted Margaris-Robinson target. Archive without ID as a matching complete proof announcement; the full proof has not been independently certified.

further_archive.title: Does convexity under every sectionwise contraction characterize ellipsoids?
further_archive.reason: The exact-set formulation admits an elementary boundary counterexample: the open Euclidean unit ball together with one point on its unit sphere. Every positive-measure affine section has the same barycenter as its open-ball section. Contraction yields the interior of the ellipsoid |z|^2+|w|^2/r^2<1, together with at most one boundary point; this is convex for every orthogonal splitting X plus X-perp and every 0<r<1. The original set is neither an open nor a closed ellipsoid. Archive this literal formulation without ID. This does not resolve the intended rigidity question modulo null boundary changes, or the compact-convex-body version.

further_archive.title: The Debarre–de Jong dimension conjecture for lines on smooth Fano hypersurfaces
further_archive.reason: Chenglong Yu, arXiv:2610.38812v1, submitted 28 October 2026, Theorem 1.3(i), announces nonemptiness and pure expected dimension 2n-d-3 for every smooth complex degree-d hypersurface with 2<=d<=n. Degree one is elementary. Any counterexample over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field descends to finitely many characteristic-zero coefficients, embeds into C and preserves Krull dimension after algebraically closed base change; thus the complex theorem covers the admitted field scope. Archive without ID as a matching complete announcement, without certifying its full proof.

further_archive.title: Homogeneous polynomial approximation on arbitrary symmetric convex bodies
further_archive.reason: Colbrook arXiv:2610.38877v1, submitted 28 October 2026, explicitly announces uniform boundary approximation by consecutive homogeneous degrees for every origin-symmetric convex body without smoothness. This matches the full admitted target in all dimensions. Archive without allocating an ID as a matching complete proof announcement; the new proof has not been independently certified.

further_archive.title: Jordan structure from spectral-radius preservation
further_archive.reason: Colbrook and Stepaniants, arXiv:2610.40470v1 (29 October 2026), Theorem 1.1, explicitly proves that every unital surjective complex-linear spectral isometry between arbitrary unital complex C-star-algebras is a Jordan isomorphism. The displayed hypotheses and square-preservation conclusion match the entire target. Archive without ID as a matching complete proof announcement; the claim of accompanying Lean verification has not been independently rebuilt here.

further_archive.title: Even trace coefficients for arbitrary Hermitian matrix pairs
further_archive.reason: Dinh, Le and Vuong, Positive Planar Measures for Spectral Pinching and the Corrected BMV Conjecture, 22 October 2026, Theorem 4.3 claims for every Hermitian pair the pinching inequality whenever the second-variable second derivative of a scalar polynomial is globally nonnegative. Take p(s,t)=s^(m-k)t^k with both exponents even. Then its second derivative is nonnegative, and the commuting pinched trace Tr(A^(m-k) E_A(B)^k) is nonnegative. The symmetrized word coefficient is thus nonnegative in every dimension, including k=0 trivially. This exactly implies the submitted even-BMV assertion for indefinite Hermitian matrices. Archive as a matching complete announcement, not an independently certified proof, and allocate no AIM ID.
